title: Reports: periodic outcome reports
summary: Per-party periodic reports from a markdown template and the records (commitments, verify results, events), drafted to company/work/reports/<party>/, reviewed by a seat other than the sender, and sent only through the external gate (category message or publish) within the sendsPerDay limit.
enableWhen: there is a counterparty to report to

tools.purpose: draft per-party reports from a template, review them, send only through the external gate

limits.why: the module's own caps; shipped closed, opened only by the owner

meters.why: every report that left, with its gate clearance and reviewer
